description:
About Freshpaint:

Healthcare is a $4+ trillion industry in the U.S. alone, and it’s undergoing a rapid digital transformation.

Hospitals, digital health companies, and life sciences organizations rely on analytics and advertising tools to reach patients, measure performance, and grow. But those tools weren’t built for regulated healthcare data. That creates real compliance risk and forces teams to choose between growth and privacy.

Freshpaint eliminates that trade-off.

We’re a privacy-first data platform that helps healthcare organizations use modern marketing and analytics tools without exposing protected health information (PHI). Freshpaint sits between a company’s website or app and the third-party tools they use, automatically detecting and controlling sensitive data before it’s shared.

In short: we let healthcare teams move fast, safely.

Backed by Top Investors

Freshpaint is backed by some of the most respected names in technology, including:

  • Y Combinator (OpenAI, Stripe, Airbnb, Coinbase, DoorDash)

  • Intel Capital (Broadcom, Astera Labs, VMware, RedHat, MongoDB)

We’ve raised tens of millions of dollars in funding to build the privacy infrastructure layer for healthcare’s digital future.

Who we’re looking for
We’re looking for a driven, aspiring seller who wants to build a career in sales and get very good, fast. You don’t need years of experience. You do need drive, discipline, and the curiosity to learn a complex space. The right person is competitive, coachable, resilient, and relentless: they can take a “no” on a cold call and pick up the phone again with the same energy. They want to understand why healthcare marketing is hard (HIPAA, tracking pixels, privacy risk) and can turn that into short, sharp outreach that gets a busy executive’s attention. They run their own day in a remote environment, apply feedback on the very next call, and see progress as part of winning.

What you’ll be doing
As an SDR on our Provider team, you’ll build net-new pipeline by booking first meetings with marketing, digital, and privacy leaders at health systems and specialty groups. These are the people who decide how patient data is used in marketing, and your work gives our Provider AEs a steady flow of high-quality first conversations. You’ll start with a structured 2-week onboarding bootcamp, get certified on our pitch and objection handling, and be fully ramped by the end of your second month. After that, it’s about steady results: high activity, real personalization, and clean execution.

Primary responsibilities

  • Ramp quickly: complete onboarding and certification, book your first qualified meeting within 30 days, and hit full quota by the end of Month 3

  • Book qualified first meetings and source new opportunities with marketing, digital, and privacy leaders at health systems and specialty groups

  • Consistently hit quota after ramp (roughly 5–6 opportunities and 10 meetings per month)

  • Help source $1.6M+ in qualified Provider pipeline in your first two full quarters

  • Own your weekly activity: 400 calls, 75 net-new prospects added to sequence, and 10+ live conversations

  • Research accounts using ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and news triggers to write outreach that references something real about the account

  • Invite target accounts to Freshpaint-led events (Growth Clinics, House Calls, webinars) and turn attendees into opportunities

  • Keep HubSpot clean: log every activity, book through the right flow, and make sure every meeting is attributed correctly

  • Review your own calls in Gong, take coaching, and keep improving your messaging

Desired skills & experience

  • Up to 1 year of SDR, BDR, or outbound sales experience, or a background in a target-driven, customer-facing role and a clear reason you want to be in sales

  • Comfortable with high-volume cold calling; rejection doesn’t slow you down

  • Aggressive in pursuit of expanding your knowledge & becoming a subject matter expert

  • You own your development: You don’t wait for your manager to find your gaps and help you solve for them. You analyze self performance and spot the areas for growth and build action plans around them.

  • Strong, concise writing: you can write a short, direct email a VP would actually read

  • Curiosity and willingness to learn a new, regulated industry in depth (no technical background required)

  • Organized and process-minded; you see CRM hygiene as part of doing the job well

  • Self-starter who can manage your own schedule in a fully remote environment and asks for help early

  • Coachable: you look for feedback and act on it fast

  • Se

  • Adaptable in a startup where priorities, products, and plays change often

Nice to haves

  • Exposure to healthcare, health tech, or another regulated industry

  • Experience with HubSpot (CRM and sequences), Gong, ZoomInfo, or LinkedIn Sales Navigator

  • Familiarity with digital marketing concepts like ad platforms, analytics, or tracking pixels

  • A track record of competing and winning, whether in sales, athletics, or something else

Perks & Benefits

We take care of our team—here’s a peek at what you get when you join:

  • Competitive pay + generous equity

  • Half-day Fridays, every Friday

  • 16 weeks fully paid parental leave (eligible after 6 months; commission-based roles receive 100% base salary during leave)

  • Flexible PTO with a required 2-week minimum

  • Top-tier health, dental & vision (100% covered for you, 80% for dependents)

  • Intentional & engaging company offsites (past trips: Arizona, Jackson Hole, Nashville, New Orleans & more)

And more! Check out our careers page for the full list.
